lines.text: What a meaningful day. The AZX will finally be able to take passengers to the surface.
I'm surprised. This outfit... is really comfortable.
The safety of our passengers is my top priority.
I feel reassured having you on this mission, Commander. I look forward to working with you.
Would you like to have coffee with me? I'll get it ready.
The scenery outside feels even more beautiful. I believe it's because you're with me, Commander.
Don't worry about me. Go attend to any business you might have.
It feels like a shame to enjoy this view alone. Would you come and enjoy it with me?
Someday, the trains here will be able to run freely on the surface too.
I wonder what the coffee at the Outpost's cafe tastes like.
No wonder the station looks so spotless. Soline did an excellent job cleaning it.
I will take you safely to your desired destination.
This is a great start. Thank you.
This will significantly improve my long-term efficiency.
It feels as though I've entered the safest stretch of the tracks.
Thank you for thinking of me personally.
This will help me in my work. I will treasure it.
I love this. I will never forget this day thanks to you, Commander.
You did all this for me? That's... very kind of you. Thank you.
Every time I see you, Commander, I notice my emotions... are not what they usually are.
This is serious. When I see your face... I get nervous.
The AZX is ready to depart at any time.
Please let me know where you'd like to go.
Departing now for our destination.
The train ride will be bumpy. Please be careful.
I'll show you what the upgraded AZX can do.
Preparing to remove all obstacles.
Enemies ahead. Activating response protocol.
One moment, please.
Train services will not be interrupted.
I will protect my passengers.
Have faith in me.
I'll get you to your destination!
Hold on tight and don't get hit!
Enemy down.
Got them.
Obstacle removed.
Ugh.
Argh!
Damn...
I never wanted to stop the train... I'm sorry.
We have arrived at your destination. It's been a pleasure escorting you here safely.
